proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3848 khalla gives Lahnda/Awan khal hide and Punjabi khall skin, alongside h-less kal in Romani. Goj kal skin is compared with this regional skin family with deaspiration qualified; the deeper relation to challi is doubtful. Exact survey form kal is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1268 āmra gives Punjabi ambī and Hindi ambī mango in the regional borrowed amb series. Goj āmbī fits this feminine mango noun; precise intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact survey form āmbī is preserved.
